item.title: The road signs that teach travellers about France
item.description:
📝 The road signs that teach travellers about France12 hours agoShareSaveAnna RichardsShareSavePhilippe Collier(Credit: Philippe Collier)For more than 50 years, France's brown motorway signs have done far more than point the way: they've sold the country's history, culture and identity in seconds. Rather than being a distraction, the brown signs served to break autopilot mode and were thought to improve road safety. "He deplored the road signs that came afterwards.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/travel/article/20260327-the-road-signs-that-teach-travellers-about-france

item.title: There is No Spoon. A software engineers primer for demystified ML
item.description:
📝 There Is No Spoon A machine learning primer built from first principles. Written for engineers who want to reason about ML systems the way they reason about software systems. This primer builds that intuition.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/dreddnafious/thereisnospoon

item.title: Coding Agents Could Make Free Software Matter Again
item.description:
📝 I mean free software in Stallman’s sense: software that gives users the freedom to run it, study it, modify it, and share it. SaaS made it hard to care software freedom because most people never saw or touched the source code of software they depended on in the first place. The printer’s software was proprietary.
🔗 Read more: https://www.gjlondon.com/blog/ai-agents-could-make-free-software-matter-again/
